subject.title: No owner role on an org I created

question: After verifying the live `xerg` creation and membership records, should the operator restore `jasonacurry` as owner immediately and require a broader ownerless-organization audit?
rationale: Changing live organization ownership is security-sensitive, and source inspection cannot establish identity, historical role mutations, or the production blast radius.

options.title: Repair and audit
options.body: Verify the creation history, restore the creator's owner membership, and inspect other organization publishers for the same invariant violation.

options.title: Repair this organization
options.body: Restore the verified owner role now but defer broader reconciliation until a reproducible source or migration cause is identified.

options.title: Investigate before mutation
options.body: Leave the role unchanged until production logs and membership history establish how the publisher-only state arose.

recommendation.title: Repair and audit
recommendation.body: Verify the creation history, restore the creator's owner membership, and inspect other organization publishers for the same invariant violation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from recent Convex and release-area history, though exact ownership is not conclusive.
